description: STUDENT ONLY ACCOMMODATION. Archway Court is Student specific accommodation and is shared accommodation. The complex is made up of 12 Houses & 3 Apartments around a central courtyard with rooms to rent in each house. Archway is a gated development and tenants have pedestrian access via the pedestrian gate with a swipe fob. Currently we have limited availability for renting for the academic year & can be extended by mutual agreement. Licence terms are for a minimum of  6 months with 9 months or 12 month licence options also available. . Archway Court is independent living shared accommodation. This gated complex is within walking distance of the a range of 3rd level institutions/ colleges, including the new Grangegorman Educational Campus, Trinity College, The Kings Inn, DIT and Dublin Business School and the City Centre, O'Connell Street/ Henry Street, Dublins main shopping and entertainment district. Wifi service and bin collections are included in the rental price. The layout of the bedrooms varies from one room to the other. Public transport is easily accessible with a number of bus routes nearby and the Luas (Tram) runs along Mountjoy Street, right outside the gate. There are both single and shared rooms within the houses. Monthly rent prices vary depending on the room type. The Kitchens, Living Rooms and Bathrooms in the houses are shared by all Students. Twin Room from €550, Single Room from €875, Twin Apartment from €750. All prices are per person, per month
